criteria.requirement: Implement chardet.details.detect_details(data, *, names="legacy") retaining actual raw encoding/confidence/language while reporting canonical Python codec and availability. Explicit names="python" may select the canonical codec only when supported; unusual UCS4 labels must retain their identity and report unsupported status instead of being relabelled UTF32. Distinguish empty/no-match, snapshot mutable bytearray input and reject invalid policies/types without changing detect defaults.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
